profile.title: Senior iOS & Mobile Developer
profile.tagline: Crafting beautiful, performant cross-platform mobile experiences.
bio: I'm a mobile engineer with three plus years building production iOS and cross-platform apps. My day-to-day is split between Swift and SwiftUI for native iOS and Dart and Flutter for cross-platform work, with a strong bias toward clean architecture, reactive patterns, and shipping software that feels effortless.

I care deeply about the details that separate good apps from great ones: thoughtful animation, predictable state, fast cold-start, and interfaces that respect the user. I've shipped messaging, productivity, commerce, and Firebase-backed products from greenfield to App Store.

When I'm not writing code, I'm refining design systems, mentoring teammates, and exploring how new platform capabilities can make the next release a little quieter, a little faster, and a little more delightful.

experience.summary: Designing and shipping native iOS and cross-platform mobile apps for global clients across fintech, health, and consumer.
highlights: Senior iOS developer on client apps spanning HSBC Health, Payslate, Playdate, Milagro SmartWait, and Marina Racquet Club.
Architected SwiftUI + UIKit hybrid screens, MVVM + Clean Architecture, async/await migrations, and CoreData/SwiftData persistence layers.
Delivered Flutter apps with Bloc state management, Firebase integration, and offline-first SQLite storage.
Owned end-to-end App Store release pipelines: Fastlane lanes, Xcode Cloud, TestFlight rollouts, and crash triage via Crashlytics.
Mentored juniors, ran code reviews, and set architecture standards across the mobile guild.
